{{Top|leg}}
'''Mining ships''' were specialized [[Starship/Legends|starships]] designed with the sole purpose of conducting deep-space [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations. Mining ships were used to mine [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], or mine [[Gas/Legends|gas]] from [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]]. The [[Asteroid Prospector AP-300]] was a model of asteroid miner, while the [[Garman-class Gas Miner|''Garman''-class Gas Miner]] was a model of gas mining starship.
